_note: Documented Indian corporate incidents for the pilot back-test (report Sec. VII-C). 'date' is the day the event became public; the incident day scored is date + 4 days and the control day is 60 days before that. 'symbol' is the NSE symbol under which Yahoo Finance now carries the price history (Zomato → ETERNAL, Tata Motors → TMPV); null = never listed (scored on news only). 'aliases' are extra names a headline may use.
